# Load Data

```{r load_data}
cat("\n\n## ", "Loading GRS table", params$grs_table, "\n\n")
dat <- read.csv(params$grs_table)

has_pheno <- !is.null(params$pheno_table) &&
  nzchar(params$pheno_table) &&
  file.exists(params$pheno_table) &&
  file.info(params$pheno_table)$size > 0

if (has_pheno) {
  cat("\n\n## ", "Loading pheno table", params$pheno_table, "\n\n")
  pheno <- read.csv(params$pheno_table)
  if (!"IID" %in% names(pheno)) stop("Phenotype table must contain 'IID' and 'FID' column")
  pheno <- pheno %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~na_if(.x, -9)))
  dat$FID <- as.character(dat$FID)
  pheno$FID <- as.character(pheno$FID)
  dat$IID <- as.character(dat$IID)
  pheno$IID <- as.character(pheno$IID)
  dat <- merge(dat, pheno, by=c("FID", "IID"), all.x=TRUE)
} else {
  cat("\n\n## ", "No pheno table specified", "\n\n")
  pheno <- NULL
}

grs_vars <- grep("^GRS", names(dat), value = TRUE)
if (length(grs_vars)==0) stop("No GRS variables detected")

pheno_vars <- if (!is.null(pheno)) setdiff(names(pheno), c("FID","IID")) else character(0)
has_pheno_vars <- length(pheno_vars) > 0

prefix <- params$prefix
```

```{r debug_check, echo=TRUE}
save_plot <- function(p, name, w = 7, h = 5) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(outdir, paste0(name, ".png")),

    width = w,
    height = h,
    dpi = 300

}
```

# 4️⃣ Create Quantiles

```{r quantiles}
q_option <- tolower(params$quantiles)
all_types <- c("terciles","quartiles","quintiles","deciles")
chosen_q <- if (q_option=="all") all_types else unlist(strsplit(q_option,","))

cat("\n\n## ", "Chosen quantiles:", chosen_q, "\n\n")

add_quantiles <- function(dat, grs_vars, chosen_q) {
  make_split <- function(vec, n) dplyr::ntile(vec, n)
  
  for (g in grs_vars) {
    vec <- dat[[g]]
    if ("terciles"  %in% chosen_q) dat[[paste0(g, "_terciles")]]  <- make_split(vec, 3)
    if ("quartiles" %in% chosen_q) dat[[paste0(g, "_quartiles")]] <- make_split(vec, 4)
    if ("quintiles" %in% chosen_q) dat[[paste0(g, "_quintiles")]] <- make_split(vec, 5)
    if ("deciles"   %in% chosen_q) dat[[paste0(g, "_deciles")]]   <- make_split(vec, 10)
  }
  dat
}

dat <- add_quantiles(dat, grs_vars, chosen_q)

```

# 5️⃣ Boxplots QUANTILE-GRS

```{r boxplots1, results='asis', fig.show='asis', fig.keep='all', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
plot_grs_quantiles <- function(dat, grs_vars, chosen_q, prefix, outdir) {
  for (g in grs_vars) {
    for (q in chosen_q) {
      q_col <- paste0(g, "_", q)
      if (!q_col %in% names(dat)) next
      
      df <- dat[, c(g, q_col)]
      names(df) <- c("GRS", "QUANTILE")
      df <- df[!is.na(df$GRS) & !is.na(df$QUANTILE), ]
      if (nrow(df) == 0) next
      
      df$QUANTILE <- factor(df$QUANTILE)
      
      p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = QUANTILE, y = GRS, fill = QUANTILE)) +
        geom_violin(alpha = 0.4, trim = FALSE) +
        geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
        scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues") +
        labs(title = paste(g, "by", q),
             x = q,
             y = g) +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
      
      safe_print_plot(p)
      ggsave(file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_", g, "_", q, "_boxplot.png")),
             p, width = 15, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300)
    }
  }
}

plot_grs_quantiles(dat, grs_vars, chosen_q, prefix, outdir)

```

# 6️⃣ Boxplots Multipanel QUANTILE-PHENO

```{r boxplots2, results='asis', fig.show='asis', fig.keep='all', fig.width=10, fig.height=6, warning=FALSE}

plot_pheno_boxplots_multipanel <- function(dat, grs_vars, pheno_vars, chosen_q, prefix, outdir) {
  
  if (length(pheno_vars) == 0) return()  # no phenotypes to plot
  
  for (ph in pheno_vars) {
    
    # Determine if phenotype is categorical (<= 5 unique values) or quantitative
    unique_vals <- length(unique(na.omit(dat[[ph]])))
    is_categorical <- unique_vals <= 5
    
    for (g in grs_vars) {
      
      for (q_type in chosen_q) {
        q_col <- paste0(g, "_", q_type)
        if (!(q_col %in% names(dat))) next
        
        # Prepare data
        df_facet <- dat %>%
          select(all_of(c(ph, q_col, g))) %>%
          rename(PHENO = 1, QUANTILE = 2, GRS = 3) %>%
          filter(!is.na(PHENO), !is.na(GRS)) %>%
          mutate(GRS = factor(GRS))
        
        if (nrow(df_facet) == 0) next
        
        # Create plot depending on phenotype type
        if (is_categorical) {
          # Categorical phenotype → x = PHENO, y = GRS
          df_facet <- df_facet %>% mutate(PHENO = factor(PHENO))
          p <- ggplot(df_facet, aes(x = PHENO, y = as.numeric(as.character(GRS)), fill = PHENO)) +
            geom_violin(alpha = 0.4, trim = FALSE) +
            geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
            labs(title = paste("GRS distribution across", ph, "(categorical)"),
                 x = ph,
                 y = paste("GRS (", g, ")", sep = "")) +
            theme_bw() +
            theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
        } else {
          # Quantitative phenotype → x = QUANTILE, y = PHENO
          df_facet <- df_facet %>% mutate(QUANTILE = factor(QUANTILE))
          p <- ggplot(df_facet, aes(x = QUANTILE, y = PHENO, fill = QUANTILE)) +
            geom_violin(alpha = 0.4, trim = FALSE) +
            geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
            labs(title = paste("Phenotype", ph, "across", q_type, "of", g),
                 x = paste(q_type, "level"),
                 y = ph) +
            theme_bw() +
            theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
        }
        
        # Print and save
        print(p)
        ggsave(file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_", ph, "_", q_col, "_boxplot_MULTI.png")),
               p, width = 15, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300)
      }
    }
  }
}

plot_pheno_boxplots_multipanel(dat, grs_vars, pheno_vars, chosen_q, prefix, outdir)

```

# 7️⃣ Boxplots QUANTILE-PHENO (Categorical Only)

```{r boxplots_categorical, results='asis', fig.show='asis', fig.keep='all', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

plot_pheno_boxplots <- function(dat, grs_vars, pheno_vars, chosen_q, prefix, outdir) {
  
  ## If phenotype is quantitative → keep QUANTILE on x, PHENO on y
  ## If phenotype is categorical / binary → do NOT use QUANTILE on x
  ## instead: GRS on x, PHENO on y (and flip axes compared to the quantile plots)
  
  for (ph in pheno_vars) {
    
    is_quantitative <- is.numeric(dat[[ph]]) &&
      length(unique(na.omit(dat[[ph]]))) > 5
    
    for (g in grs_vars) {
      
      ## ================================
      ## CASE 1: Quantitative phenotype
      ## ================================
      if (is_quantitative) {
        
        for (q in chosen_q) {
          q_col <- paste0(g, "_", q)
          if (!q_col %in% names(dat)) next
          
          df <- dat[, c(ph, q_col)]
          names(df) <- c("PHENO", "QUANTILE")
          df <- df[!is.na(df$PHENO) & !is.na(df$QUANTILE), ]
          if (nrow(df) == 0) next
          
          df$QUANTILE <- factor(df$QUANTILE)
          
          p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = QUANTILE, y = PHENO, fill = QUANTILE)) +
            geom_violin(alpha = 0.4, trim = FALSE) +
            geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
            scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues") +
            labs(title = paste(ph, "by", q, "of", g),
                 x = q,
                 y = ph) +
            theme_bw() +
            theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
          
          safe_print_plot(p)
          ggsave(file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_", ph, "_", g, "_", q, "_boxplot.png")),
                 p, width = 15, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300)
        }
        
        ## ================================
        ## CASE 2: Categorical phenotype
        ## ================================
      } else {
        
        df <- dat[, c(ph, g)]
        names(df) <- c("PHENO", "GRS")
        df <- df[!is.na(df$PHENO) & !is.na(df$GRS), ]
        if (nrow(df) == 0) next
        
        df$PHENO <- factor(df$PHENO)
        
        p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = PHENO, y = GRS, fill = PHENO)) +
          geom_violin(alpha = 0.4, trim = FALSE) +
          geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
          scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues") +
          labs(title = paste(g, "by", ph),
               x = ph,
               y = g) +
          theme_bw() +
          theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
        
        safe_print_plot(p)
        ggsave(file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_", ph, "_", g, "_grs_boxplot.png")),
               p, width = 15, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300)
      }
    }
  }
}

plot_pheno_boxplots(dat, grs_vars, pheno_vars, chosen_q, prefix, outdir)

```

# 8️⃣ Scatterplots GRS-PHENO (Quantitative Only)

```{r scatterplots, results='asis', fig.show='hold', fig.keep='all', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

plot_pheno_scatter <- function(dat, grs_vars, pheno_vars, prefix, outdir) {
  for (ph in pheno_vars) {
    if (!is.numeric(dat[[ph]])) next
    if (length(unique(na.omit(dat[[ph]]))) <= 5) next
    
    for (g in grs_vars) {
      for (q in chosen_q) {
        q_col <- paste0(g, "_", q)
        if (!q_col %in% names(dat)) next
        
        df <- dat[, c(g, ph)]
        names(df) <- c("GRS", "PHENO")
        df <- df[!is.na(df$GRS) & !is.na(df$PHENO), ]
        if (nrow(df) == 0) next
        
        p <- ggplot(df, aes(GRS, PHENO)) +
          geom_point(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
          geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "steelblue") +
          stat_poly_eq(aes(label = paste(..eq.label.., ..rr.label.., sep = "~~~")),
                       formula = y ~ x, parse = TRUE) +
          labs(title = paste(g, "vs", ph, "by", q),
               x = g,
               y = ph) +
          theme_bw() +
          theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
        
        safe_print_plot(p)
        ggsave(file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_", g, "_", ph, "_scatter.png")),
               p, width = 15, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300)
      }
    }
  }
}

plot_pheno_scatter(dat, grs_vars, pheno_vars, prefix, outdir)

```

# 9️⃣ Scatterplots GRS-PHENO split by QUANTILE (Quantitative Only)

```{r scatterplots_quantile, results='asis', fig.show='hold', fig.keep='all', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

plot_pheno_scatter_quantile <- function(dat, grs_vars, pheno_vars, chosen_q, prefix, outdir) {
  for (ph in pheno_vars) {
    if (!is.numeric(dat[[ph]])) next
    if (length(unique(na.omit(dat[[ph]]))) <= 5) next
    
    for (g in grs_vars) {
      for (q in chosen_q) {
        q_col <- paste0(g, "_", q)
        if (!q_col %in% names(dat)) next
        
        df <- dat[, c(g, ph, q_col)]
        names(df) <- c("GRS", "PHENO", "QUANTILE")
        df <- df[!is.na(df$GRS) & !is.na(df$PHENO) & !is.na(df$QUANTILE), ]
        if (nrow(df) == 0) next
        
        df$QUANTILE <- factor(df$QUANTILE)
        
        p <- ggplot(df, aes(GRS, PHENO)) +
          geom_point(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
          geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "steelblue") +
          stat_poly_eq(aes(label = paste(..eq.label.., ..rr.label.., sep = "~~~")),
                       formula = y ~ x, parse = TRUE) +
          facet_wrap(~ QUANTILE) +
          labs(title = paste(g, "vs", ph, "by", q),
               x = g,
               y = ph) +
          theme_bw() +
          theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
        
        safe_print_plot(p)
        ggsave(file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_", g, "_", ph, "_", q, "_scatter.png")),
               p, width = 15, height = 15, units = "cm", dpi = 300)
      }
    }
  }
}

plot_pheno_scatter_quantile(dat, grs_vars, pheno_vars, chosen_q, prefix, outdir)
```

# 🔟 Decile Trends

```{r trends, results='asis', fig.show='asis', fig.keep='all', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

plot_decile_trends <- function(dat, grs_vars, pheno, prefix, outdir) {
  for (g in grs_vars) {
    dec_col <- paste0(g, "_deciles")
    if (!dec_col %in% names(dat)) next
    
    trend <- aggregate(
      dat[[pheno]],
      by = list(decile = dat[[dec_col]]),
      FUN = mean,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    if (all(is.na(trend$x))) next
    
    p <- ggplot(trend, aes(decile, x)) +
      geom_line() +
      geom_point() +
      labs(
        title = paste("Trend across deciles for", g),
        x = "Decile",
        y = pheno
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
    
    safe_print_plot(p)
    ggsave(file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_", g, "_", pheno, "_trend.png")),
           p, width = 15, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300)
  }
}

###plot_decile_trends(dat, grs_vars, pheno_vars[1], prefix, outdir)

select_first_quantitative_pheno <- function(dat, pheno_vars, min_unique = 5) {
  for (ph in pheno_vars) {
    if (is.numeric(dat[[ph]]) &&
        length(unique(na.omit(dat[[ph]]))) > min_unique) {
      return(ph)
    }
  }
  NULL
}
quant_pheno <- select_first_quantitative_pheno(dat, pheno_vars)

if (!is.null(quant_pheno)) {
  plot_decile_trends(
    dat    = dat,
    grs_vars = grs_vars,
    pheno  = quant_pheno,
    prefix = prefix,
    outdir = outdir
  )
} else {
  message("Skipping decile trends: no quantitative phenotype available")
}

```
